message: Adding check constraint "CHK_end" on "holidays" cannot fail: "holidays"."end_date" was added earlier in this migration, so every row has NULL there. PostgreSQL still reads the whole table once while blocking reads and writes.
why: A CHECK constraint is satisfied when its expression is true or NULL. With the new column NULL in every row, the check cannot be false for any existing row. Validating it still takes one full read of the table under an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock.
safeAlternative: Nothing needs to change. On a large table, adding the constraint with NOT VALID skips the read; existing rows cannot break it, and new rows are always checked.
